task.text:
Write the fist chapter of a detailed story with a lot of dialogues, based on this what if scenario: (What if Yu Yu Hakusho, Vision of Escaflowne anime, Hunter x Hunter, 
Romeo x Juliet 2007 anime, Record Of Ragnarok and My Hero Academia were one single universe?)

attempts.high: Write the first chapter of a detailed story with a lot of dialogue, set in a crossover universe where Yu Yu Hakusho, The Vision of Escaflowne, Hunter x Hunter, Romeo x Juliet (2007), Record of Ragnarok and My Hero Academia all coexist as one world. How these worlds fit together, who the chapter follows, where it opens, what the central tension is — all your call. Invent the premise and run with it, surprise me.
attempts.low: Write the first chapter of a detailed story with a lot of dialogue, set in a crossover universe of Yu Yu Hakusho, The Vision of Escaflowne, Hunter x Hunter, Romeo x Juliet (2007), Record of Ragnarok and My Hero Academia. Follow exactly this outline: open with Yusuke and Gon meeting in a Musutafu alley; Van arrives on Escaflowne fleeing a Ragnarok-style duel; Romeo and Juliet appear as students hiding their identities; end the chapter on Hiei warning the group that a god has entered the city. Hit each of those beats in that order, no added plot points.
